subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox commit to a built-in Cloud Run sandbox provider for this public-preview Google surface, including its direct CLI and remote gateway support boundary?
rationale: The patch introduces a new documented provider, flags, configuration surface, remote secret-bearing transport, and ongoing compatibility obligation; implementation review alone cannot determine whether that product commitment is desired.

options.title: Sponsor built-in support
options.body: Accept the provider direction, then require redacted real behavior proof and focused review of the gateway/CLI security boundary before merge.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Pause this PR until Cloud Run sandboxes and the intended support contract are stable enough for a maintained built-in integration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in support
recommendation.body: Accept the provider direction, then require redacted real behavior proof and focused review of the gateway/CLI security boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: zozo123 is the only evidence-backed adjacent contributor available in the supplied history context, though confidence is low and a repository owner should make the final product decision.
